name: Business Days Calculator
description: Add or subtract business days from a date, or count business days between two dates — skipping weekends and any holidays you list.

faq.question: Does this know public holidays automatically?
faq.answer: No — holiday calendars vary by country, region, and even industry, so there's no single correct built-in list. Add the specific dates that apply to you in the holidays box, and both calculators on this page will exclude them alongside weekends.

faq.question: What happens if I enter a negative number of business days to add?
faq.answer: It subtracts instead — moving backward from the start date, skipping weekends and holidays the same way, useful for questions like "what date was 10 business days before this deadline?"
